---
title: "Car Stats Explorer"
---

## Car Price vs. Horsepower

```{r}
#| echo: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(plotly))

cars <- read_csv(
  "https://gist.githubusercontent.com/dvinubius/33486dad2dc86319f0a06ffdb1d4f34f/raw/",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

plot_cars <- cars |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MSRP), MSRP > 0,
    !is.na(`Engine HP`), `Engine HP` > 0,
    !is.na(`Vehicle Size`)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hover_label = paste0(
      "<b>", Make, " ", Model, " (", Year, ")</b>",
      "<br>Price: ", scales::dollar(MSRP, accuracy = 1),
      "<br>Horsepower: ", `Engine HP`, " hp",
      "<br>Vehicle size: ", `Vehicle Size`,
      "<br>Style: ", `Vehicle Style`
    )
  )

plot_ly(
  data = plot_cars,
  x = ~MSRP,
  y = ~`Engine HP`,
  color = ~`Vehicle Size`,
  colors = c("#2A9D8F", "#E76F51", "#457B9D"),
  text = ~hover_label,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 7, opacity = 0.6)
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Price (MSRP)", tickformat = "$,.0f"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Engine horsepower (hp)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Vehicle size")),
    hovermode = "closest"
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = TRUE, displaylogo = FALSE)
```
